name: Avimaia
sum: Enantiornithean from the Xiagou Formation of China preserved with an unlaid egg inside its body.
holotype: A partial skeleton from the Xiagou Formation, Gansu (number in Bailleul et al. 2019).
exceptional: An egg inside the body cavity.
biology: The female died with an egg still in her body.
author: Bailleul et al. 2019
